<!-- pr-reviewer: aaabe76233034efcc771c0e59476f4fbf2ce643b -->
Needs a refresh against main before merge. The delta review is clean.

The rework claim is correct. `git show --remerge-diff aaabe7623` shows that the merge of main changed only two files:

- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs`: the export list is the union. It exports the two #3354 notes and main's `StartSide`, `pocket_started_on` and `pocket_avoid_started_on`.
- `crates/motion/src/machining2d/pocket.rs`: the Zigzag note reads `side.start`, the parameter of the new law.

`PassStart::rank` is not in the tree. `sided_passes` does not exist. `level_rings::ring_plan` keeps the incompleteness guard: when the start-side plan leaves more than `LEFT_TOL` unswept, the area takes the Auto plan and carries `fallback_note`, which contains `RINGS_FALLBACK`. `level_rings.rs` and `pocket_hsm.rs` are identical to main. The Auto path is unchanged: `pocket()` and `pocket_entered*()` pass `Auto`, `ring_plan` skips the side plan for Auto, and `cleared_links` stays false, so earlier output keeps its bytes. No golden, `.cl`, `.nc` or snapshot file changed.

**What looks good**

- The digest bytes are one helper, `write_pass_start`, written only off Auto. 2D Offset and 2D Pocket use it.
- Undo, the project round trip and the refusal of an unknown word are pinned in `pocket_pass_start_rides_mcp_undo_and_the_file`.
- Zigzag and rest say by name that the option does not apply. The choice is not dropped silently.
- No `unwrap`, `expect` or `panic!` is added outside test files. The two files that have them are tests.
- The body has a `Changelog:` row and `Fixes #3354`; the subjects are conventional.
- No process file is in the diff now, so the `Process change: yes` line is harmless but no longer needed.

**Results, built and tested locally after a clean trial merge with main `5346bd7ac`**

The main moved during the review. The readings below are on the main of that moment.

- `camcraft-motion` `pass_start_levels`: 7 passed.
- `camcraft-app` `offset_pass_start`: 4 passed, 2 ignored (heavy lane).
- `camcraft-app` `pocket_pass_start`: 6 passed.
- `camcraft-app` lib `operation::rest_op_tests::pass_start_moves_the_pocket_stamp_only_off_auto`: 1 passed.
- `camcraft-ui` lib `egui_app::tests::pass_start::the_pocket_passes_tab_offers_pass_start_and_shows_the_draft`: 1 passed (CWD `crates/ui`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

**Requested before merge**

1. Refresh the branch against main. `origin/main` is now `fdda55e15` (the #3387 merge), and the trial merge conflicts in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs:50`. Both sides add one test at the same place: this PR adds `the_pocket_passes_tab_offers_pass_start_and_shows_the_draft`, and main adds `the_face_passes_tab_says_it_has_no_pass_order`. Resolve the union and keep both tests. The import line already names both `FACE_NO_PASS_ORDER` and `PASS_START_LABEL`. Merge main into the branch (never rebase), then comment "ready for a re-check".

**Heavy lanes**

The diff reaches these heavy lanes: `app heavy: every target` (`crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs` changed) and `motion heavy: every target` (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/mod.rs` changed). Heavy not run - owed to the cut (#3558 is P2).

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**

- `crates/app/src/operation/generate.rs:821`: the Pocket arm calls `pocket_started`, so `StartSide.stock` is `None` and `around_part` is false. The Offset arm builds a `StartSide` with the stock footprint and `around_band`. `on_wall(None)` returns true (`crates/motion/src/machining2d/level_order.rs:260`), so the Outside note can name a wall in the stock where the test proves the first ring is at the open stock edge. This changes the advisory line only, not the ring order or the cut. Consider `pocket_started_on` with the same `StartSide` as the Offset arm, or confirm that the note is intended.
- `docs/decisions/3354-pocket-pass-start.md:14` names `plan_passes_from`, which the tree does not have. The law uses `level_rings::ring_plan` and `level_pieces`.
- `crates/ui/src/egui_app/mill2d_page.rs` is 412 lines (4 added). Flag only, not a blocker.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 9fc5459494ed6553087a45631c82ebd54f7dbcb9 -->
Delta review of the refresh. Clean.

`aaabe7623..9fc545949` is two merges of main.

- `d32a8eeeb` merged `fdda55e15`. Its remerge-diff is the append-both union in `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`: the Pocket test and the Face test both stay.
- `9fc545949` merged `209f62665` (the #3402 merge). Its remerge-diff has three comment-only hunks:
  - `crates/app/src/operation/params/digest.rs`: the doc comment is the union `#3316, #3354, #3355`.
  - `crates/app/src/operation/params/mill2d.rs`: a duplicated comment is removed above the shared `digest::write_pass_start(*pass_start, h)` call. The call is unchanged.
  - `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`: the module header is the union of Offset, Pocket and Adaptive.

No function body, call or test body changed. `write_pass_start` and the Auto path are as reviewed at `aaabe7623`. `level_rings` and `pocket_hsm` carry main's version.

The readings of the earlier review stand (no rebuild): motion `pass_start_levels` 7 passed; app `offset_pass_start` 4 passed / 2 ignored; app `pocket_pass_start` 6 passed; app lib stamp test 1 passed; ui lib Pocket tab test 1 passed; clippy clean. Heavy not run - owed to the cut.

The PR is MERGEABLE. A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

The PR head matches `refs/pull/3391/head` at `07a1d5b6`. It is one merge of main (`c5bb09ed1` into `9fc545949`).

The remerge-diff is only `crates/ui/src/egui_app/tests/pass_start.rs`: the append-both union of the Pocket test and the Bore test. Face was already common. The conflict markers are gone. No source logic is hand-edited.
